neet_phy_u06_t04_1.working: v_e = sqrt(2GM/R) does not depend on the projectile's mass, so it stays 11.2 km/s.

neet_phy_u06_t04_2.working: With M = (4/3)πR^3ρ, v_e = R·sqrt(8πGρ/3), so v_e ∝ R at fixed density. 3 × 11.2 = 33.6 km/s.

neet_phy_u06_t04_3.working: At distance 2R from the centre, v = sqrt(2GM/2R) = 11.2/√2 = 11.2/1.414 ≈ 7.9 km/s.

neet_phy_u06_t04_4.working: Escape needs KE + PE = 0, and kinetic energy is a scalar, so the projection direction does not matter. A is false and R is true.

neet_phy_u06_t04_5.working: I: v ∝ sqrt(M/R), so R → R/4 gives v × 2, not × 4; I is incorrect. II: v ∝ R at constant density, so doubling R doubles v; II is correct.
